question:
Given below are four jumbled parts of a sentence. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A) has been attributed by many climate scientists

B) the unprecedented frequency of extreme weather events

C) to the steady rise in global atmospheric temperatures

D) observed across various continents over the last decade
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence logically flows from introducing a main subject (extreme weather events) to describing where it happened, and finally explaining its cause.
 
• **Part B is the first part** as it introduces the main subject of the sentence:
 
 
• "the unprecedented frequency of extreme weather events"
 
 
 
• **Part D follows** as it acts as a modifier describing where and when these events were observed:
 
 
• "observed across various continents over the last decade"
 
 
 
• **Part A is the third part** because it introduces the verb phrase and the agents performing the action:
 
 
• "has been attributed by many climate scientists"
 
 
 
• **Part C is the fourth** as it completes the phrase "attributed to" by providing the object or cause:
 
 
• "to the steady rise in global atmospheric temperatures"
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **BDAC**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement**:

"The unprecedented frequency of extreme weather events observed across various continents over the last decade has been attributed by many climate scientists to the steady rise in global atmospheric temperatures."
